verdict.rationale: Anrok's API returns the list of customer tax IDs to collect and the valid tax ID types per jurisdiction. It also verifies addresses for tax calculation and tracks international obligations, such as a UK registration threshold and obligations in 13 countries. That is only glancing support for B2B cross-border VAT handling. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time tax ID validation against official registries (e.g. VIES/HMRC), evidence of reverse-charge application on B2B cross-border invoices, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
